name: plazox
author: sistemapay

sections.description:
This free extension allows you to easily integrate and brand your eCommerce with the Plazox service, enabling your customers to pay for their purchases in installments if your virtual POS supports it.

Plazox allows consumers to split purchases into 3, 6, and 12 installments at the time of payment. It is free and risk-free for your business. The user experience has been carefully designed to encourage sales and prevent shopping cart abandonment, integrating naturally and flexibly into your eCommerce.

Benefits of Plazox for your business:
– Boost sales: Increased sales and average ticket size.
– Expand customer base: Loyal and new customers.
– Risk-free: The card issuing entity assumes the financing risk, and you receive the full purchase amount.
– Trust: A bank-backed system with no unknown intermediaries.
– Optimized experience: Seamless integration for merchants and customers.

Benefits of Plazox for your customers:
– Flexible payment: Choose 3, 6, or 12 installments.
– Immediate availability: Offered through the acquiring bank, no third-party registration required.

A brief Markdown Example

Features:
– Easy integration with WooCommerce.
– Secure and seamless payment experience.
– Boost your sales with Plazox.

Learn more about Plazox.
sections.faq:
What is Plazox?

Plazox is a payment system that allows customers to split their purchase into installments directly during checkout.

Does Plazox cost anything for merchants?

No, Plazox is free for merchants and risk-free, as the financing risk is handled by the card issuer.
